hullSideRight.note: Hull right side — Wikinger US skin (5a3d5e4e9f854eb39e8edc7e15c4dc25) shows white US Army stars prominently on hull side panels. Left-hull crop (0-500, 800-1400) shows two stars: upper at ~(175,985) and lower at ~(175,1260) in atlas coordinates. This rect captures the upper hull-right star (the primary visible badge position). The star faces the viewer from the right side panel. Annotated PNG at artifacts/badge-rects/m10_tank_destroyer.png.
